item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.30)] Applied Materials Trades More Than 25% Below Its High With Revenue at a Record
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.30)
Applied Materials (NASDAQ: AMAT) reported record fiscal third-quarter results, with revenue up 25% year-over-year to $9.1 billion and non-GAAP EPS up 41% to $3.50. Despite this strong performance and an impressive outlook for Q4 driven by AI demand, the stock fell, trading over 25% below its 52-week high. The market appears cautious due to the cyclical nature of the semiconductor equipment business and concerns about how long the current AI spending boom will last.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.28)] Ferrari’s first electric car fetches record US$40mil at auction
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.28)
Ferrari's first all-electric vehicle, the "Luce" tailor-made, sold for a record US$40 million at a Sotheby's charity auction during Monterey Car Week, making it the most expensive new car ever sold at auction. This sale surpassed Ferrari's previous record set last year with the Daytona SP3. Despite initial criticism and a drop in share price upon its unveiling, CEO Benedetto Vigna noted strong demand from both existing and new customers for the innovative model.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.14)] IBM - Why I See IBM as a Long-Term Enterprise AI and Hybrid Cloud Play
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.14)

Partnerships with OpenAI and Google Cloud are seen as strengthening this position, although execution risk remains in converting these into sustained revenue growth and cash generation. item.title: [AMZN Neutral (-0.11)] More than 1 million attic ladders sold at Home Depot, Lowe’s recalled after reported injuries
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (-0.11)

Consumers are urged to immediately stop using the affected ladders, sold under Louisville, Featherlite, Lite, and Century brands, and to obtain a free repair kit from the manufacturer's website. The ladders were sold nationwide between November 2012 and July 2026.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.40)] Constellation Energy ($CEG): The Nuclear Scarcity Play Powering the AI Demand Boom
item.description:

Constellation Energy (CEG) is positioned as a key player in meeting the surging demand for carbon-free baseload power, driven by AI data centers and electrification. Despite risks related to regulation and leverage, the article highlights CEG's strong earnings growth potential, strategic acquisitions, and attractive valuation.
